name: n8n
description: n8n connects your apps and services and runs workflows on a schedule or on an event. Teams use it to automate routine work with no code or with a little code.
licence_note: Free for use inside your own business, and for personal or non-commercial use. To offer n8n to others for money, you need a licence from n8n.

first_steps: Open the app at once and make the owner account: the first person who opens it becomes the owner.
